headline: School board to vote on Merger Committee membership and review FY28 budget timeline, strategic plan, and CESA merger study.
summary: The board will take action on Merger Committee membership and discuss the FY28 budget timeline, strategic plan development, and the Chittenden Central CESA and Act 170 Merger Study Group. It will also review consent agenda items including financial reports, hiring recommendations, and committee meeting minutes.
